title: Allo ULTRA 25K – White Peach Razz
description:
Peach, Raspberry

Introducing the ALLO Ultra 25K, the next evolution in vaping built for those who want it all. With the game-changing No Turning Back design, assembly is effortless — just snap it in and go. No twists, no fuss.

This powerhouse delivers up to 25,000 puffs of pure satisfaction, packed with ALLO’s signature flavours you know and love. Featuring USB-C charging, a 600mAh battery, and a battery life indicator, you’re always in control and ready for what’s next.

Key Features

- E-liquid capacity: 2mL + 15mL

- Battery capacity: 600mAh

- Up to 25,000 puffs

- Battery level indicator for easy monitoring

- USB-C charging port for fast, reliable power

- ALLO signature flavours for a premium vape experience

- Designed in Canada with quality and innovation
